_comment: BLG-SEC-15 / ST-04 (EPIC-02, v8.5): known-as-of-baseline snapshot for the monthly dependency-vuln-rescan.yml scheduled job. Advisory IDs listed here are treated as 'already tracked' by the workflow's dedup logic and will NOT re-trigger a new GitHub issue on every run -- only advisory IDs absent from this file are reported as 'new'. This is NOT an accepted-risk register (unlike vulnerability-scan.yml's inline CVE-2026-4539 ignore, which has explicit Cybersecurity & Trust Lead + Head of Engineering sign-off) -- these are unreviewed at baseline time and were filed as BLG-SEC-18 for Cybersecurity & Trust Lead triage. Update this file (add the advisory ID) once a finding has been reviewed and is either fixed, or a considered accept-risk decision is recorded elsewhere (e.g. inline in vulnerability-scan.yml per the CVE-2026-4539 pattern) -- do not silently let the baseline grow uncurated.

npm_audit.note: All 16 are transitive dependencies of react-scripts (CRA v5 build toolchain -- webpack-dev-server/svgo/postcss/ws chain) except react-router/react-router-dom, which is also pulled in transitively via react-scripts's own react-router-dom peer range, not the app's direct react-router-dom entry. None were individually risk-assessed before this baseline was captured -- see BLG-SEC-18.
